$description: Values Primer does not define as variables, and contrast adjustments, for the dark theme.

status-info-background.$description: Primer's bgColor-accent-muted (#388bfd1a) composited over bgColor-default, because the contract measures contrast between two colours rather than a stack

status-success-background.$description: Primer's bgColor-success-muted (#2ea04326) composited over bgColor-default, because the contract measures contrast between two colours rather than a stack

status-warning-background.$description: Primer's bgColor-attention-muted (#bb800926) composited over bgColor-default, because the contract measures contrast between two colours rather than a stack

status-danger-background.$description: Primer's bgColor-danger-muted (#f851491a) composited over bgColor-default, because the contract measures contrast between two colours rather than a stack

hover.$description: Primer shades hover with separate control colours; Polyxd needs a state-layer opacity

disabled.$description: Primer's disabled controls use its fgColor-disabled on a muted fill

min.$description: Primer's medium control is 32px; 44px is the touch target a generated surface is held to

max.$description: Characters per line for running text (Polyxd; Primer has no measure token)
